summary: Sequans Communications filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited preliminary third-quarter 2026 financial results via press release dated November 3, 2026. Revenue rose to $9.1 million, up 21.9% sequentially and 182.8% year-over-year, with gross margin of 33.0% and a net loss of $1.5 million, or $0.10 per diluted ADS. No transaction, corporate action, or structural change is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary earnings report by a foreign private issuer; no deal terms, advisor, board recommendation, or risk-arb angle applies.
